text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Tuesday, March 27, 2018 Posted by admin on March 27th, 2018 
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. Dow stock 52 week lows include General Electric (GE) and Merck (MRK). 
The Market 
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +122 points. 
Monday the Dow was up +669.40 (+2.84%) at 24,202.60. 
Year-to-date the Dow is down -2.09%. 
There were 29 Dow stocks up Monday. 
The Dow stock winners Monday were led by Microsoft (MSFT) +7.57%, Inteel (INTC) +6.32%, Apple (AAPL) +4.75% and Goldman Sachs (GS) +3.92%. 
The Dow stock loser Monday was General Electric (GE) -1.38%. 
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended higher. 
The national average price of gasoline is up a penny at $2.621 per gallon. 
Earnings Reports . 
Nike (NKE) reported earnings on 3/22/2018 after the market close of $-0.57, missing estimates calling for $0.555 per share. 
Today’s Featured Dow Stock 
Disney (DIS) 
Disney (DIS) is down -6.38% year-to-date.
